Som Lalit College vs St Xavier's College is a same-city Ahmedabad comparison. The recorded year fees and 2023 packages sit close to each other, so the official circular and the campus visit matter more than a large number gap.

sections.heading: Som Lalit College vs St Xavier's College for BCA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose St Xavier's College if you want the slightly higher recorded year fee and 2023 figures, at a year-wise total of ₹32,810, an average package of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹6 lakh.
Choose Som Lalit College if a slightly lower recorded year-wise total of ₹25,000 matters, with 2023 figures of a ₹3 lakh average and a ₹5 lakh highest package.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Som Lalit College has a recorded year-wise total of ₹25,000 for BCA. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed three-year total, until you check the college's official circular.
St Xavier's College has a recorded year-wise total of ₹32,810. The two sides are close. Confirm both official notices, including examination and other charges.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both sides have a recorded 2023 year, so the figures can be read together more fairly than on many other comparisons.

St Xavier's 2023 figures are an average package of ₹3 lakh and a highest package of ₹6 lakh. Som Lalit's 2023 figures are an average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹5 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Many Ahmedabad BCA admissions are based on Class 12 marks, sometimes with a college-level process.
Read the current official admissions page of each college for eligibility and any test or interview.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both colleges are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. St Xavier's College is a long-established campus in the city. Som Lalit is a separate college campus.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, visit both campuses. The recorded fees and 2023 averages are close enough that the classroom and commute may decide it.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On recorded 2023 averages the two sides are level at ₹3 lakh. St Xavier's has the slightly higher recorded highest package and year fee.
Som Lalit is slightly lower on recorded year fees and on the 2023 highest package.
Confirm both official circulars before you treat ₹25,000 or ₹32,810 as your actual cost.
